title: Doesn’t fit stake
text: Doesn’t fit stake. I bought 4 of these. They are cute colorful tin gnomes but there is a manufacturing defect in which the opening on the bottom of the gnome doesn’t fit the enclosed stake which explains why they were so cheap.
